evidence.title: GitHub - raunofreiberg/ui-playbook: The documented collection of UI components 🤓 · GitHub

name: UI Playbook
summary: Documented collection of 10 common UI components with functionality, best practices, accessibility and implementation notes.
description: Reference documentation for common UI components: for each one it lists expected functionality per state, best practices, implementation notes, accessibility concerns and resources, with component previews on the page. A motion page covers animation principles, durations and spring animations.
contains: documents 10 components: tooltip, button, select, notification, textfield, avatar, checkbox, motion, popover, radio
each entry covers functionality, best practices, implementation and accessibility
component previews and a search across components
motion principles with animation duration tiers and spring animations
